title: OpenSim sim:state.zones Bucket
description: ThreatArbiter-published threat-zone bucket, embedded at sim:state.zones. Carried verbatim onto SimulationState.zones and consumed by KillZoneOverlay (air_defense, red fill + boundary) and JamZoneOverlay (comm_jam_static + comm_jam_random, purple fill). Referenced by sim-state-v1.json.

air_defense.description: Air-defense (kill) zones. Each polygon is projected to ENU and fan-triangulated; polygons with < 3 vertices are skipped.

comm_jam_random.description: Randomised comm-jam zones (appear/disappear as the kernel ticks).

polygon.description: Ordered [(lat, lon), ...] vertex ring. At least 3 vertices produce a filled mesh.
